# canary help · COLUMNS=80 · colour off
Canary — portfolio, risk and order tools for Interactive Brokers
Runs locally. Broker writes require approval and trading checks.

Usage: canary <subcommand> [flags] [args]
Start: canary status — check the daemon and gateway connection

Desk
Account, positions, orders and risk

  status          Daemon + gateway health (run this first if anything fails)
  account         Net liquidation, buying power, cash, margin and daily P&L
  positions       List open stock, option, bill and bond positions
  strategies      Group option legs and close or reduce them as one guaranteed
                  combo
  portfolio       Signed allocation by asset class and GICS sector, with
                  coverage; plan reads the next portfolio action
  stress          Portfolio stress and its full risk evidence
  brief           Prioritized desk brief; full evidence with --details
  edge            Broker-truth review of past trading decisions
  short-interest  Screen FINRA short positions across US equities
  lending         Read lending income, borrowing fees and stock market context
  rules           Advisory daily rule checklist, hardest breach first; your
                  limits via rules policy
  policy          Risk constitution and policy files: limits, capital and
                  drawdown state
  recon           Post-trade reconciliation against the capital ledger
  reporting       Shared statement-reporting setup and health
  proposals       Protection proposals to close or reduce positions
  opportunities   Option exercise opportunities
  trading         Local trading gate status and configuration
  orders          Read the local order journal; never transmits
  order           Preview, place, modify, cancel, or inspect gated orders

Markets
Market conditions and analysis of named symbols

  data            Source health and checks of required data feeds
  market          Observed quotes, price history and a daily
                  price/breadth/volume tape
  technical       Trend, relative strength, ATR, and liquidity from daily bars
  watchlist       Read and edit the durable owner watchlist; no broker or policy
                  changes
  setups          Observe volume turns, discover exact standard calls and read
                  entry markouts; no trade or policy authority
  calendar        Official exchange sessions, holidays, early closes, and
                  coverage bounds
  macro           Economic releases and official publications with source
                  coverage
  regime          Market regime and all eight indicator readings

System
Run, configure and update Canary

  settings        Runtime platform preferences and observed read-only state
  app             Run the paired mobile PWA application layer
  mcp             Run the stdio MCP server for local AI clients
  daemon          Run the stateful gateway daemon (normally autospawned)
  setup           Configure a local client, app host, or shared broker reporting
  update          Self-update the Canary binary from the latest GitHub release
  restart         Gracefully restart the daemon and any running app process
  stop            Stop the local daemon and app processes
  version         Print version, commit, build date

Run canary <command> --help for usage and available actions.
Run canary <command> <action> --help for that action's flags.
Add --json to data/query commands for machine-readable output.

Colour: NO_COLOR=1 disables it; CANARY_COLOR=always|never overrides.
